Join our team as a Warehouse & Operations Associate and contribute to a mission that truly makes a difference in the fight against life-threatening diseases such as bloodcancer. 
 

In this role, you will be part of a supportive and collaborative environment within a leading global pharmaceutical company.
 

As a Warehouse & Operations Associate, your responsibilities will primarily focus on operational warehouse activities with an accurate administrative follow-up. 
 

 
• Responsible for inbound and outbound warehouse activities in a GMP-regulated environment.
 
• Receive, handle and store cryopreserved blood samples (cells) from cancer patients, which serve as the critical starting material for the manufacturing process.
 
• Manage inventory, warehouse materials and internal material requests to support other departments.
 
• Use SAP to process warehouse transactions and ensure accurate inventory records.
 
• Maintain documentation, traceability and compliance with GMP and quality requirements.
 
• Collaborate closely with other departments to support smooth day-to-day activities. 

 
 

 
• You have experience in logistics, warehousing, or operational environments, or you are eager to learn and develop yourself in this field.
 
• You work accurately, pay close attention to detail, and follow procedures to ensure quality, compliance, and safety.
 
• You are reliable, proactive, and take ownership of your responsibilities.
 
• You enjoy working in a team and collaborate effectively with colleagues across different departments.
 
• You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.
 
• You can commute independently to the site and are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

jobs.occupation: Production worker 2 shifts physical work close to Roeselare// High payment above 17euro's per hour
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a hands-on job in a growing company within the plastics industry? Do you enjoy physical work and being part of a team? Then this opportunity could be perfect for you!

To support a major new project, we are looking for motivated and committed Production Workers to join the shipping department.

Your responsibilities will include:

 
• Assisting with the assembly of wooden crates used for packaging and shipping products.
 
• Working together with a colleague to stack and assemble the crate components using an ergonomic support system.
 
• Carefully packing finished automotive parts into the crates.
 
• Securing the products properly, closing the crates with lids and straps, and preparing them for shipment.
 
• Attaching the correct shipping labels to the finished crates.

 
• You are motivated, reliable, and eager to work.
 
• You are comfortable performing physically demanding tasks.
 
• You have a hands-on mentality and enjoy working in a team environment.
 
• You have a good command of Dutch and/or English.
 
• You are flexible and willing to work in a 2-shift system.
 
• Experience in production or logistics is an asset but not required.

A strong financial profile with people management skills and a passion for process optimisation? As an AP Manager at Lotus Bakeries, you will have the opportunity to take on a key role within an international environment in Lembeke.

In this versatile role, you will combine people management with operational responsibility and process optimisation. You will have the freedom to take initiative, implement improvements and contribute to building efficient and future-proof Accounts Payable processes.

 

 

 

 

 

 

Your responsibilities:

As an AP Manager, you will be responsible for Accounts Payable services across multiple entities and countries.

• Lead, coach and develop the AP team (9 people), allocate workloads and ensure efficient operations and continuity.
• Coordinate the entire AP flow, from invoice receipt, processing and approval through to payments and supplier management, while ensuring process quality and timely execution.
• Monitor KPIs and SLAs, analyse workload and performance, and take action where necessary to further improve service delivery.
• Act as the first point of contact for complex AP matters and work closely with Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Treasury and external stakeholders.
• Ensure compliance with accounting policies, tax and legal requirements, as well as internal controls, and support internal and external audits.
• Analyse AP and cash management processes, including payment timing, DPO and cash discounts, and initiate concrete improvements.
• Identify opportunities for automation and process optimisation and contribute to finance transformation and system projects, such as SAP, VIM and Concur.
 

 

Your profile:

• You hold a Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or an equivalent field, combined with at least 5 years of relevant experience in AP or Accounting, preferably within an international or shared services environment.
• You have experience in people management and know how to coach, motivate and further develop a team.
• You have strong knowledge of AP accounting, VAT and invoice-to-pay processes, as well as experience with ERP systems; knowledge of SAP and VIM is a plus.
• You are analytical and KPI-driven, with strong knowledge of MS Excel and standard Office tools.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English; knowledge of French is a plus.
• You are organised, proactive and solution-oriented, with the ability to set priorities effectively in a dynamic FMCG environment.
• You are a strong communicator with a stakeholder-oriented mindset and identify with values such as team spirit, open dialogue and passion.

Take the next step in your accounting career within a growing healthcare environment. An exciting opportunity is available for a Senior Accountant seeking a varied role with regional exposure across the Benelux. This position offers the chance to combine accounting expertise, financial reporting, tax compliance, and process improvement while contributing to an organisation dedicated to improving quality of life through healthcare solutions.

As a Senior Accountant, you will:

• Manage the full accounting cycle for several Benelux entities.
• Process purchase invoices, bank transactions, payroll entries, and general ledger postings.
• Perform monthly, quarterly, and year-end closing activities.
• Prepare and execute supplier payments.
• Assist with VAT returns, Intrastat declarations, and tax-related filings.
• Support the preparation of annual accounts and audit documentation.
• Review and reconcile intercompany transactions and balances.
• Handle HR-related administrative tasks for selected entities.
• Contribute to financial projects and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Provide support on ad hoc accounting and reporting activities.

About You

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
• You have at between 4 and 10 years of experience in accounting, financial reporting, or controlling.
• You possess solid knowledge of Belgian accounting regulations; knowledge of Luxembourg and Dutch accounting standards is an asset.
• You have experience with audits, tax compliance, and financial controls.
• You work confidently with Excel and the MS Office suite.
• You are familiar with ERP systems; experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is a strong advantage.
• You have a good understanding of VAT and corporate tax regulations within the Benelux region.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and French, with a good command of English.
• You demonstrate strong analytical skills and excellent attention to detail.
• You manage deadlines effectively and can prioritize multiple responsibilities.
• You work autonomously while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
• You take a proactive and solution-oriented approach to challenges.
• You handle sensitive financial information with integrity and discretion.
• You explain financial data clearly to both finance and non-finance stakeholders.

Are you a night owl with a talent for solving technical challenges?

Do you thrive in a modern production environment where teamwork and quality are top priorities? Then this is the opportunity for you!

Your role

As a Maintenance Technician in the fixed night shift, you are essential to our production process. You ensure that machines operate at their best, perform preventive maintenance, and resolve malfunctions quickly and effectively. With your technical skills and problem-solving mindset, you keep the production running even while the world sleeps.

What will you do?

• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on machines and installations.
• Detect, analyze, and fix malfunctions (primarily electrical, ideally with mechanical expertise).
• Start up and optimize production lines.
• Actively contribute to improving the reliability and efficiency of the equipment.
• Collaborate with a team and report to the technical service manager.
Work schedule

• 2 workdays (2 x 7.36 hours) and 2 weekend days (2 x 11 hours), offering a steady yet varied schedule.
 

 

• A technical degree or relevant experience in a production environment.
• Broad technical knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and pneumatics; PLC knowledge is a plus.
• A flexible, positive attitude and strong problem-solving skills.
• A team player who is eager to learn and improve.
• Fluency in Dutch or English.

As a Line Supervisor 2-shifts, you are the key figure in the packaging department. You lead a motivated team and ensure that the machines perform optimally and the final products leave the facility perfectly packaged. You work closely with the production manager and planning department in a clean, high-tech, and fast-paced work environment where no two days are the same.

In the role of Line Supervisor 2-shifts, you carry the responsibility for the entire packaging process. Your concrete tasks include:

• Process Monitoring: You correctly start up and guide the packaging process from A to Z to guarantee an efficient flow.
• Team Leadership: You coordinate, motivate, and guide the team on the packaging floor.
• Quality & Hygiene: You ensure strict compliance with quality standards and hygiene regulations within the food sector.
• Problem Solving: You quickly resolve operational issues and malfunctions, and continuously look for process optimizations.
• Reporting: You report directly to the production manager regarding progress, results, and any bottlenecks.
• Communication & Planning: You check packaging orders and streamline communication between production planning and the storage of the finished product.
• Digitalization: You assist with the further rollout and everyday use of the MES & ERP systems on the packaging floor.
To be successful as a Line Supervisor 2-shifts or experienced packaging team leader, you recognize yourself in the following profile:

• Experience: You have experience within a production environment, ideally in the food industry.
• Leadership & Insight: You have technical insight and possess the natural ability to manage and motivate an operational team.
• Flexibility: You are a real go-getter with a flexible mindset who is happy to work in a fixed 2-shift system.
• Communication: You have a good command of the English language (for communication on the work floor).
• IT Skills: You have good computer skills and quickly pick up new software (such as ERP or MES).

As a future butcher / deboner of pork meat, you will work on different lines with tasks such as cutting shoulders, bellies, and ribs. 

Experience is an asset, but motivated newcomers are welcome. 

Thanks to the Butchers Academy, you will receive comprehensive training, followed by a permanent contract and annual evaluations offering opportunities for advancement.

We are looking for ambitious and eager-to-learn individuals who can start early (start at 4.55 AM) and are flexible in their schedules depending on the season. 

You should be comfortable working in a cold environment and have an affinity for the food industry (pork meat), along with the associated quality and hygiene standards. 

You must be physically capable of standing and working all day and place importance on workplace safety. 

Language is not a barrier; everyone has equal opportunities, whether you speak English, French, or Dutch.

For our client, a company in Lokeren specialized in the assembly of car seats and a supplier to Volvo Trucks, we are looking for an 
Assembly Worker.
 

What will you do?
 
 

• You will be responsible for assembling car seats on the production line. 

• You will make sure that your part of the assembly process is completed accurately and to a high standard. 

• You will regularly switch workstations and work closely with your colleagues. 
 

• You already have experience as an 
assembly or production worker. 

• You are willing and able to work in 
2 shifts in Lokeren.  

• You are comfortable with physical work, as some components can be quite heavy.. 

• You speak and understand 
English well.

What will you do?

What does your day look like as a truck driver with a Moffett?

  • You start early in the morning (between 5 AM and 6 AM) from our base in Deinze. Loading is not necessary – your truck is already prepared the night before. You follow a fixed route for a regular customer. On average, you make 4 to 6 deliveries per day across the Benelux.
  • You are responsible for unloading the goods yourself using the Moffett forklift attached to your truck. Our dispatch team is always ready to support you in case of questions, delays, or unexpected situations.
  • Finished with your deliveries? Then you drive back to Deinze – job done!

Interested?
Send your CV to Eeklo@absolutejobs.be

What do we expect from you?

  • You're not afraid to roll up your sleeves and get things done
  • Physical work is part of the job for you – not an obstacle
  • You have your own transportation, as the truck stays on our premises
  • You can communicate fluently in Dutch, French, or English
  • You're a team player who’s ready to help out where needed
  • You keep your truck and trailer clean and tidy
  • You maintain clear communication with dispatch and other departments

jobs.occupation: Talencia Consulting - SAP FICO Functional Analyst
jobs.description:
Talencia is looking for a SAP FICO Functional Analyst for one of its clients.

Location : Brussels periphery

Start date : ASAP

Duration : Permanent (Open-Ended Contract, CDI)

Our client is a well-established retail organization looking for a SAP FICO Functional Analyst to join its internal team and take an active role in the day-to-day management and evolution of their SAP landscape.
Description 

• Act as a functional reference for SAP, with a strong focus on FICO.

• Provide day-to-day functional support and analyse incidents and business requirements.

• Translate business needs into functional SAP solutions and specifications.

• Understand end-to-end processes including purchasing, order flows, warehouse operations and Finance.

• Analyse interactions between SAP and external applications, interfaces and third-party systems.

• Work closely with developers and technical teams, understanding technical specifications and code without being a developer yourself.

• Participate in functional analysis, testing and implementation of new solutions.

• Gradually take ownership of existing knowledge through close collaboration and knowledge transfer from experienced SAP professionals.

You are a SAP professional with a strong functional mindset, capable of understanding both business processes and their technical environment. Along, you bring:

• 5+ years of SAP experience.

• Strong knowledge of SAP FICO.

• Experience as a SAP Functional Analyst, SAP Business Analyst, SAP Consultant, Application Consultant or similar.

• A good understanding of end-to-end SAP processes and integrations.

• The ability to turn business requirements into practical functional solutions.

• Enough technical understanding to communicate effectively with developers and understand interfaces and system interactions.

• A working knowledge of English, Dutch and French

As a future butcher / deboner of pork meat, you will work on different lines with tasks such as cutting shoulders, bellies, and ribs. 

Experience is an asset, but motivated newcomers are welcome. 

Thanks to the Butchers Academy, you will receive comprehensive training, followed by a permanent contract and annual evaluations offering opportunities for advancement.

We are looking for ambitious and eager-to-learn individuals who can start early (start at 4.55 AM) and are flexible in their schedules depending on the season. 

You should be comfortable working in a cold environment and have an affinity for the food industry (pork meat), along with the associated quality and hygiene standards. 

You must be physically capable of standing and working all day and place importance on workplace safety. 

Language is not a barrier; everyone has equal opportunities, whether you speak English, French, or Dutch.

Are you a skilled welder with an eye for detail and a passion for metalworking? Then we have a great opportunity for you!

As a welder, you will be responsible for accurately assembling and welding a variety of metal constructions based on technical drawings and specifications. You play an important role in delivering high-quality end products and actively contribute to maintaining craftsmanship and reliability.

 

You will work closely with your colleagues to ensure projects are completed efficiently and within set deadlines. In addition, you act as a representative of the organization in contacts with clients and partners.

·        Experience in welding, preferably semi-automatic (TIG is a strong plus)

·        Accuracy and a strong focus on quality

·        Flexibility and the ability to work under pressure

·        Team spirit and a positive work attitude

·        A professional and presentable appearance

·        Proficiency in Dutch or English

·        Willingness to learn and further develop your skills

WE’RE HIRING!
 

We recruit a motivated sales advisor who sees a challenge in the following responsibilities and focal points:
 
 

• You provide customers with an excellent and premium shopping experience. You provide special and inspiring service beyond customer expectations and maintain a loyal and personal approach. 

• You apply mandatory sales standards and use up-to-date technical product knowledge to increase sales. 

• You follow guidelines related to store opening and closing, dress code, hygiene, health and safety, money matters, etc. 

• You ensure a pleasant and clean store floor with beautifully presented and correctly priced products. 

• You assist in managing inventory. 

• You are eager to learn and willing to take the necessary training courses. 

We expect a sales advisor to: 
 
 

• Be flexible and be able to work weekends.  

• Be very customer and service oriented.  

• Communicate fluently in both Dutch and English. Other languages are a big plus.  

• Be a flexible, enthusiastic, and smooth team player.  

• Be informed on new market trends, client wishes and the competition.  

• Act as an ambassador of the company, who lives by the values and shows passion for the brand.

You will work in Ninove, in a modern and highly automated environment specialized in logistics automation and automated warehouse systems.

The company develops, integrates and maintains automation solutions that help warehouses, production environments and distribution centers operate more efficiently.

Jobomschrijving

For an internationally active company specialized in automated warehouse systems and logistics automation, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Automation Technician / PLC Technician to join the permanent night shift team.

You will ensure that highly automated warehouse and logistics systems continue to operate efficiently and reliably.

As an Automation Technician, you will be responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of automated installations.

Your responsibilities:
	
• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on complex automated installations.	
• Diagnosing and resolving technical faults and breakdowns.	
• Troubleshooting issues in electrical, mechanical and automated systems.	
• Working with PLC controls, sensors, motors and SCADA systems.	
• Ensuring that automated warehouse installations operate safely and efficiently.	
• Carrying out technical interventions independently and identifying the root cause of malfunctions.	
• Recording maintenance activities and interventions correctly in the CMMS system (Sprocket).	
• Working independently during the permanent night shift, while consulting colleagues when necessary.	
• Contributing to the safety, reliability and efficiency of the installations.

	
• A technical degree in electromechanics, electricity, automation and/or mechanics.	
• Several years of experience as an Automation Technician, Maintenance Technician, Service Technician, Troubleshooting Technician or PLC Technician.	
• Basic knowledge of industrial automation and PLC systems.	
• Knowledge of sensors, motors, electrical components and technical installations.	
• Experience with or an interest in SCADA and CMMS systems.	
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.	
• A proactive, independent and accurate working attitude.	
• A good command of Dutch and/or English.	
• No fear of heights, as you may work at different levels within the automated installations.	
• Good physical fitness.	
• A strong interest in technology and a willingness to continue learning.	
• The flexibility and motivation to work in 2 shifts

WE’RE HIRING!
 

The store manager is responsible for the daily direction of the store, in order to become a profitable store, within the predetermined budgets.
 

The job of the store manager includes, but is not limited to, these following important tasks:
 

 
 

Analysis of the shop performance
 
 

• You do everything to reach the sales plans. 

• You collect and analyze the KPI’s and initiate ways to improve them.  

Client Service
 
 

• You apply the obligated sales standards and you use up-to-date technical product knowledge to increase the sales. You ensure that this is also applied by the store personnel. 

• You provide a special and inspiring service, beyond expectation of the customer and handle a loyal and personal approach.  

Personnel Management
 
 

• You coach, train, motivate and develop the team in order to reach the goals. 

• You set up the personnel planning in an efficient way. 

• You follow-up the accomplishments of the team very well and you make sure that the rules are being followed.  

Stock
 
 

• You manage the stock in a correct way. 

• You check that the products are priced correctly and you minimize the losses in order to reach the company numbers.  

Operations
 
 

• You are responsible for an accurate and a trustworthy compliance of the daily procedures (money and banking, shop opening and closing, health and safety, etc.). 

• You ensure that the repairs are being followed-up professionally and accurately.  

Merchandising, Marketing & Promotions
 
 

• You take care of the shop and window presentation and lay-out in accordance with the defined standards. 

• You take care of a full preparation and implementation of promotions and the correct use of promotion materials. 

We expect a store manager to:
 
 

• Have a previous experience as a store manager in a high-level brand retail environment. 

• Have good organizational, managerial, coaching and communicative skills. 

• Be flexible and be able to work weekends. 

• Communicate in a clear, concise and understandable way and to listen to others. 

• Be very client-oriented. 

• Communicate fluently in Dutch and English. 

• Be able to influence, take decisions and responsibility in a rapidly evolving and changing environment. 

• Be stress resistant. 

• Be informed on new market trends, client wishes and the competition. 

• Act as an ambassador of the company, who lives by the values and shows passion for the brand.

jobs.occupation: Cream Consulting by Audensiel - SAP HR / HCM Expert
jobs.description:
As an SAP HR consultant, your role is to help clients with the implementation, migration and operation of SAP HCM.
Your tasks 

• Analyzing and solving issues within SAP HCM:

• Functional issues

• Process optimization

• Preparing and following functional specifications

• Collaborating with the business and the development teams

• Correcting and modifying reports through ABAP language

What do WE expect from our Consultant ?

• You have good knowledge in SAP HR or SAP HCM especially on the following modules: ESS, MSS, OM, PA, PT, PY, TM,

• Experience with SAP Solution Manager

• Good knowledge of ABAP and ABAP OO: reports' modification and correction, debugging...

• You have knowledge of LSO (learning solution) and Belgian post pay processes: DmfA, DIMONA, BELCOTAX, FINPROF

• You have experience in many phases of SAP HR/HCM projects: analyze, implementation, deployment, support, project management

• You have proven business background in large companies

• You are customer-oriented

• You have very good communication skills in face-to-face

• You have a cultural openness and adaptability, you are pragmatic and have the capacity to keep things simple

• You are fluent in English and French or Dutch with a passive understanding of the other one

The Capacity Management team, is organized around 3 main domains: Mainframe and Tandem technologies, Open systems technologies and a transversal domain supporting Business and Service Capacity Management (including the data and reporting infrastructure).

The Capacity Management team is responsible for a full set of activities covering both Capacity and Performance aspects. The team

• collects the demand and forecasts the consumption of IT infrastructure

• handles capacity and performance operations to prevent Capacity and/or Performance incidents to occur

• is involved in various projects for ensuring applications are rightly sized and well-tuned before going in production.

About the role

You will work as a Senior IT Capacity Management Engineer in the Open Systems Technologies Domain. This domain is responsible for the capacity and performance management on these platforms

• Windows (including Service Fabric)

• Linux (including OpenShift)

• Hypervisors: ESXi, Ahv

• Distributed Storage: Powermax, ECS, Cohesity

• Network infrastructure

• Azure

Responsibilities

• Daily monitoring of the capacity and performance of the open system platforms

• Identification and investigation of capacity and performance incidents / problems

• Collaborate to the publication of the yearly capacity plan and its monthly follow-up

• Participate to projects to ensure that the capacity process is properly applied during the design phase

• Participate to projects to ensure that the non-functional requirements are properly tested and the objectives achieved

• Post launch follow up

• Capacity modelling

• At least 10 years of experience with IT capacity management and performance engineering processes

• Proven experience with virtualized Windows and/or Linux systems on ESX or Ahv

• Experience with the following platforms is a must:

• VMware ESXi

• Nutanix Ahv

• OpenShift

• Microsoft Azure

• Experience with the following tools is a must:

• Splunk (Power User certificate is an asset)

• VMware vSphere Client

• Nutanix Prism

• Dynatrace

• Good knowledge about one or more of our Storage systems: Powermax, ECS, Cohesity

• Good knowledge of SQL language, Excel, REST API, Ansible, Perfmon, Linux PCP

• Good English communication skills

• Good analytical skills

• Collaborative mind-set

Nice to have:

• Agile and DevOps

• Power BI

• Scripting languages: Python, PowerShell, Bash,

About the Role
 

Ecosoft 22 BV is looking for a reliable and motivated 
Warehouse Worker to join our team in Zele.
 

You will support the daily warehouse operations and help ensure the accurate and timely receipt, storage, preparation, and dispatch of goods.
 

Your Responsibilities
 
 

• Receive incoming goods and check quantities and condition. 

• Load and unload trucks. 

• Store goods in the correct warehouse locations. 

• Pick and pack customer orders. 

• Prepare goods for shipment. 

• Perform stock counts and support inventory control. 

• Maintain a clean, organised, and safe warehouse. 

• Report damaged goods, stock discrepancies, or operational issues. 

• Operate warehouse equipment in accordance with safety requirements. 

• Operate a forklift and/or reach truck if appropriately certified. 

Your Profile
 
 

• At least 
2 years of relevant warehouse experience. 

• Experience with goods receiving, order picking, packing, and inventory handling. 

• Basic computer skills; experience with ERP or WMS systems is an advantage. 

• Forklift and/or reach truck certificate is an advantage. 

• Driving licence B is an advantage. 

• Basic English sufficient for daily operational and safety communication. 

• Knowledge of Dutch or Ukrainian is an advantage. 

• Able to safely perform the manual handling tasks required for warehouse work. 

• Reliable, responsible, and well organised. 

• Able to work independently and as part of a team. 

• Flexible and proactive approach to work.
